Ukrainian letter units were generated offline with explicit IPA using Holos ONNX acoustic profiles.
English letter units were generated offline using Piper en_US-amy-low, explicit English IPA, and native duration alignment.
Both were converted with OpenVoice V2 to the same target embeddings used for sentences.
No additional Holos or English Piper model is loaded for spelling in this package.
Piper model reference: https://huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices/tree/main/en/en_US/amy/low
